quote.text: The money is in the follow-up.
quote.author: Alex Hormozi

schedule: No calls scheduled — check Calendly for any new bookings.
focus: Your GoHighLevel trial ends June 12 — six days out — and your entire CRM, pipeline, and all 27+ leads live inside it. Add a payment method to GHL today so the pipeline doesn't lock right when a lead is ready to talk. Losing GHL means losing every lead record you've paid $17 CPL to collect.

Still 0 closed from 27+ leads while FB Ads burns ~$35/day — the bottleneck is follow-up, not lead flow. Text the 5 warmest unbooked leads in GHL a direct booking link before noon. Every day they sit cold, you're spending another $35 chasing new leads instead of closing ones you already bought.

An email from rudy92642@gmail.com titled "Novaro AI Verification Qualification Confirmed" is pushing a Google Drive link — this is phishing using your brand name, not a real prospect or partner. Don't click the link — delete it. No legitimate verification ever comes from a random Gmail with a Drive link.
gmail_summary: No prospect replies or warm conversations. Two flags worth acting on: GoHighLevel emailed that your trial ends June 12 — your CRM and pipeline live there — and a phishing email from rudy92642@gmail.com is impersonating Novaro AI with a Google Drive "verification" link (don't click). Everything else is personal noise: Binance terms update, theScore deposit and new-login alerts, BofA Zelle payments, student-aid autopay reminder, and poker/Skool newsletters.
